background: L3 runtime closure for TP-DMX-PR1304-RED-LANE-PATH-REGEX-HARDENING-002. Automated review on this packet's own prior test-only draft (PR #1325) found and this session independently reproduced a live bypass: RedLaneScanner silently failed to block exact-match FORBIDDEN_PATHS entries carrying a control character, because PR #1322's \Z re-anchoring correctly fixed the wildcard rules but regressed the exact-match rules on this consumer, which has no independent control-character layer the way the hook does. Adds an unconditional scanner-side short-circuit mirroring the hook's, plus a regression matrix covering exact-match, wildcard, exemption-spoof, arbitrary-malformed, and clean-control cases (wildcard cases ported from PR #1321, head 353bd8b245beb2c137f1ef94b45227d885328fed, fetched and hash-verified before extraction). Round 2 addresses further automated-review findings on the round-1 PR: fixed a mutation-test methodology flaw (bare loop only observed the first failing probe; parametrized so all 13 probes are independently verified), pinned the donor content digest as an expected value, tightened the packet's HEAD-verification step wording, corrected the packet header's authority fields (which had gone stale after runtime authorization was granted), and documented one automated-review finding that cited a nonexistent git SHA as factually wrong. red_lane_scanner.py is unchanged between round 1 and round 2. src/dopemux/dcp/red_lane_rules.py and .claude/hooks/dcp_surface_guard.py are untouched throughout, per packet scope. This PR does not merge as part of this proof.
